description:
Sahwa, a human disciple of the Goddess, meets Daru, an expert in the art of transformation. Upon meeting him, Sahwa grants her wish and wants to live a truly human life, begging her teacher, Baekhwa Shinseon, who guesses what will happen to Sahwa and grants it. At the same time, an Imperial Palace talent recruitment room is attached to the village, and Sahwa leaves the island with a man named Gaon and boards a boat to the Imperial Palace...
